text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval for bargaining mandates with the following unions within Civic Theatres Toronto - Unifor Local 2003E and SEIU Local 2.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Authorized the bargaining mandate with Unifor Local 2003E, as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 29, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Authorized the bargaining mandate with SEIU Local 2, as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 29, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto. 3. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 29, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential in its entirety as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
